jobs.title: Teachers Primary
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE ? Collège Champittet, a school of reference in the Lake Geneva region since 1903, offers excellent education to generations of Swiss and foreign students. Its unique spirit revolves around academic performance, multilingualism and values such as respect and trust. The school is part of the Nord Anglia Education family, the world's leading premium schools’ organisation with 89 schools in 32 countries. In this dynamic environment, both local and international, we invite you to join our team. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
• Create a quality teaching environment conducive to learning, fostering learner agency and implementing the principles of positive discipline
• Act as a coach by setting learning objectives that are challenging, inspiring and motivating, within the Collège philosophy
• Adapt teaching to the strengths and needs of each pupil, including those with high ability or with special educational needs
• Communicate effectively and regularly with parents about their children’s achievements and learning
• Give students regular feedback, both orally and through accurate rating PROFILE AND COMPETENCES
• Bachelor ’s degree
• PGCE or equivalent
• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least five years’ experience, ideally in an international environment
• Native English speaker with fluent French
• Valid Swiss work permit and clean criminal records

jobs.title: Enseignants-es Primaire
jobs.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Le Collège Champittet, école de référence dans la région lémanique depuis 1903, offre une excellente formation à des générations d'étudiants suisses et étrangers. Son esprit unique s'articule autour des performances académiques, du multilinguisme et de valeurs telles que le respect et la confiance. Le Collège fait partie de la famille d'écoles Nord Anglia Education, leader mondial des écoles internationales avec 88 écoles dans 32 pays. Dans cet environnement dynamique, à la fois local et international, nous vous invitons à rejoindre notre équipe. RESPONSABILITÉS PRINCIPALES
• Développe un climat propice à l’apprentissage et à l’acquisition des compétences attendues
• Formule et met en œuvre les objectifs de la section en accord avec les objectifs généraux du Collège
• Collabore avec ses collègues pour harmoniser la progression de l’enseignement
• Définit et adapte avec ses collègues, les chefs de file et les doyennes, les objectifs et contenus du programme de la section Primaire
• Effectue périodiquement une évaluation du niveau atteint
• Rencontre régulièrement les parents d’élèves pour un point de situation
• Gère le budget alloué à sa classe pour les activités et sorties PROFIL ET COMPÉTENCES
• Diplôme d’enseignement supérieur en sciences de l’éducation et/ou pédagogie
• 5-7 d’expérience en classes primaires
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
• Extraits de casier judiciaire vierges
• Nationalité suisse ou permis de travail valide

jobs.title: IB Teachers
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE ? Collège Champittet, a school of reference in the Lake Geneva region since 1903, offers excellent education to generations of Swiss and foreign students. Its unique spirit revolves around academic performance, multilingualism and values such as respect and trust. The school is part of the Nord Anglia Education family, the world's leading premium schools’ organisation with 89 schools in 32 countries. In this dynamic environment, both local and international, we invite you to join our team. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
• Teach Math, Physics, Sciences, Human Sciences or Arts etc. in the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme
• Leverage a variety of teaching approaches to deliver the curriculum, including ICT integration
• Act as a learning coach by setting objectives that motivate and challenge students
• Adapt teaching to the strengths and needs of all students, whether highly able or with special educational needs
• Communicate regularly and effectively with parents about their children’s achievements and learning
• Provide students with regular and constructive feedback, both orally and through accurate grading PROFILE AND COMPETENCIES
• University degree in their field of expertise
• Teaching qualification at graduate level or above
• Qualified IB teacher
• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least seven years’ experience, ideally in an international school environment
• Excellent communication skills, flexibility and team spirit
• English mother tongue and working knowledge of French
• Clean criminal records
• Swiss/EU citizenship or valid Swiss work permit

jobs.title: Boarding Assistant 2026.2027
jobs.description:
For an immediate start to June 2027 OUR PHILOSOPHY At Beau Soleil, we believe it’s what you do that counts. This philosophy holds true in all that we do as staff and for our students. We are a community that believes in the power of action, engagement and participation, inside and outside of the classroom. Our unique holistic education is built around four core values: Respect, Responsibility, Ambition and Determination, which provide a framework to community life for our international student body. Our students come from over sixty different countries, with diverse academic backgrounds and a wide range of future aspirations. With curricular programmes in both English and French, students graduate with an IB or High School Diploma. Within this framework, small class sizes allow for a flexible programme and staff are encouraged and supported to bring new ideas to all that they do. OUR COMMUNITY Our location in the heart of Villars-sur-Ollon, offers an enviable lifestyle with access to skiing in the winter months and a multitude of outdoor and sporting activities throughout the year. Montreux, Lausanne and Geneva are all within easy reach for cultural adventures and inspiration. The Beau Soleil campus is an inspiring place to work with facilities that are second to none. Our ongoing campus development and maintenence programme ensures that our students and staff thrive in an environment of which they can be rightly proud. YOUR PROFILE We are looking for a caring, reliable and enthusiastic Boarding Assistant to join our community for an immediate start. Working closely with the Housemaster/mistress (HM) and Deputy Housemaster/mistress (DHM), you will help foster a warm and supportive atmosphere — a true “home away from home” where students feel comfortable, respected and motivated to reach their full potential. As a constant presence in the house, you will play an essential role in the daily life of our students — offering guidance, encouragement and a listening ear. Whether you are helping with studies, joining in evening activities or simply sharing everyday moments, your contribution will help make boarding life both meaningful and memorable. This residential position offers a unique opportunity to become part of a vibrant international community and to gain valuable experience in pastoral care, education and youth development. It’s particularly suited to recent graduates or young professionals who are compassionate, responsible and eager to make a positive difference in the lives of young people. At Beau Soleil, you’ll help shape an environment where kindness and effort are celebrated, curiosity is encouraged, and every student feels truly at home — a place where both students and staff can grow and flourish. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Working with the HM and DHM to ensure the successful running of the house to provide the best possible care and experience for the students in the house
• Getting to know the students in the house and supporting them as individuals
• Being an active, dynamic and positive presence in the house during the course of the day and evening
• Assisting with house administration as required
• Extensive involvement in the weekend programme
• 6-8 lessons a week supporting in lessons
• Supporting two activities or sports teams across the year
• Overnight supervision in the Boarding House
• Helping at La Sionnaire during the Winter season (chalet on the ski slopes)
• Study supervision
• Working alongside the Health Centre team to provide support and take students to doctors/dental appointments
• Reception duties
• Airport transfers
• Attend weekly Training and Support Meetings
• Any other duties which may be required from time to time by the School EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Qualified to degree level
• English native speaker or high level of English comprehension. Good level of French is helpful but not essential
• Good IT skills EXPERIENCE
• Experience of working with young people in a residential setting is helpful but not essential PERSON SPECIFICATION
• Enthusiasm and willingness to get involved in a wide variety of activities
• A team player
• Proactive and willing to take the initiative
• Confident communication skills
• Good organisation and planning skills
• A good sense of humour
• Ability to form good working relationships within the house team, boarding team and across the school
• Willingness to follow an internal CPD programme during the course of the year
• European passport holder for compliance with Swiss work permit regulations WHAT WE OFFER
• A 10 month fixed contract, from September 2026 to June 2027, for an immediate start.
• Accommodation is included for the duration of your contract (subject to social charges)
• Food is included during term time (subject to social charges)
• Basic health insurance (Lamal) is provided and paid for by the College
• Full season ski pass and equipment hire provided START DATE Immediate start to 30 June 2027. HOW TO APPLY Applications should be made via Beau Soleil recruitment website, https://www.beausoleil.ch/careers and should contain a CV, letter of application and the details of two professional referees. The closing date for applications is Wednesday, 30 September 2026 . Successful short listed candidates will be contacted straight away with initial discussions conducted remotely by telephone or video call. Collège Alpin Beau Soleil is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. A police check is required prior to appointment.

With curricular programmes in both English and French, students graduate with an IB or High School Diploma. Montreux, Lausanne and Geneva are all within easy reach for cultural adventures and inspiration. The Beau Soleil campus is an inspiring place to work with facilities that are second to none. YOUR PROFILE We are looking for a caring, reliable and enthusiastic Boarding Assistant to join our community for an immediate start. Working closely with the Housemaster/mistress (HM) and Deputy Housemaster/mistress (DHM), you will help foster a warm and supportive atmosphere — a true “home away from home” where students feel comfortable, respected and motivated to reach their full potential. As a constant presence in the house, you will play an essential role in the daily life of our students — offering guidance, encouragement and a listening ear. Whether you are helping with studies, joining in evening activities or simply sharing everyday moments, your contribution will help make boarding life both meaningful and memorable. This residential position offers a unique opportunity to become part of a vibrant international community and to gain valuable experience in pastoral care, education and youth development. It’s particularly suited to recent graduates or young professionals who are compassionate, responsible and eager to make a positive difference in the lives of young people. At Beau Soleil, you’ll help shape an environment where kindness and effort are celebrated, curiosity is encouraged, and every student feels truly at home — a place where both students and staff can grow and flourish. • Working with the HM and DHM to ensure the successful running of the house to provide the best possible care and experience for the students in the house
• Getting to know the students in the house and supporting them as individuals
• Being an active, dynamic and positive presence in the house during the course of the day and evening
• Assisting with house administration as required
• Extensive involvement in the weekend programme
• 6-8 lessons a week supporting in lessons
• Supporting two activities or sports teams across the year
• Overnight supervision in the Boarding House
• Helping at La Sionnaire during the Winter season (chalet on the ski slopes)
• Study supervision
• Working alongside the Health Centre team to provide support and take students to doctors/dental appointments
• Reception duties
• Airport transfers
• Attend weekly Training and Support Meetings
• Any other duties which may be required from time to time by the School EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Qualified to degree level
• English native speaker or high level of English comprehension. Good level of French is helpful but not essential
• Good IT skills EXPERIENCE
• Experience of working with young people in a residential setting is helpful but not essential PERSON SPECIFICATION
• Enthusiasm and willingness to get involved in a wide variety of activities
• A team player
• Proactive and willing to take the initiative
• Confident communication skills
• Good organisation and planning skills
• A good sense of humour
• Ability to form good working relationships within the house team, boarding team and across the school
• Willingness to follow an internal CPD programme during the course of the year
• European passport holder for compliance with Swiss work permit regulations WHAT WE OFFER
• A 10 month fixed contract, from September 2026 to June 2027, for an immediate start.
• Accommodation is included for the duration of your contract (subject to social charges)
• Food is included during term time (subject to social charges)
• Basic health insurance (Lamal) is provided and paid for by the College
• Full season ski pass and equipment hire provided START DATE Immediate start to 30 June 2027. Successful short listed candidates will be contacted straight away with initial discussions conducted remotely by telephone or video call. jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE ? Collège Champittet, a school of reference in the Lake Geneva region since 1903, offers excellent education to generations of Swiss and foreign students. Its unique spirit revolves around academic performance, multilingualism and values such as respect and trust. The school is part of the Nord Anglia Education family, the world's leading premium schools’ organisation with 89 schools in 32 countries. In this dynamic environment, both local and international, we invite you to join our Academic Team. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
• Design and implement an ICT curriculum that aligns with educational standards and promotes criti-cal thinking and problem-solving
• Deliver engaging and interactive lessons that cater to diverse learning styles and adapt teaching to the strengths and needs of each pupil, including those with high ability or with special educational needs
• Create a quality teaching environment conducive to learning, fostering learner agency and imple-menting the principles of positive discipline
• Act as a coach by setting learning objectives that are challenging, inspiring and motivating, within the Collège philosophy, and provide students with regular feedback, both orally and through accu-rate rating
• Communicate effectively and regularly with parents about their children’s achievements and learning PROFILE AND COMPETENCIES
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT
• PGCE or equivalent
• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least five years’ experience, ideally in an in-ternational environment
• Native English speaker with fluent French
• Valid Swiss work permit and clean criminal recor If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES Organisation and development of activities on the evening schedule in the Boarding House (7pm – 10pm Monday to Friday starting as soon as possible from 24 August). One position is available for a male. YOUR PROFILE You are a team player with strong interpersonal skills, a positive attitude, and an organised approach to your work. Flexible and proactive, you enjoy working with students and contributing to their well-being in an educational environment. Previous experience in camps or similar settings is an asset. Good English communication skills are essential. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities. Collège du Léman is part of the Nord Anglia Education family of more than 80 premium schools, educating students in over 30 countries.

jobs.title: Activity Leader
jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE You will provide, lead, and supervise a variety of activities within the Extracurricular Department. You will also be responsible for maintaining and updating communication with the department team as well as with CDL parents whose children attend the programs. As an Activity Leader, you will work every day from 3:00 p.m. to 6:45 p.m., and from 12:00 p.m. on Wednesdays. Working hours may be adjusted slightly depending on operational needs. Position start date : 18.09.2026 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Providing attentive supervision and support to students throughout the day, ensuring their safe movement between activities, facilities, and designated locations
• Supervising and coordinating activities with external providers, on and off campus
• Maintaining effective communication and responding promptly to emergencies or safeguarding concerns
• Maintaining and updating administrative and operational tracking tools SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
• Language: fluent both in English and French
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Ability to engage in an empathetic, yet effective manner
• Strong analytical skills
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Positive attitude
• Results-oriented
• Proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
• Optional: Familiarity with the iSams platform ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international day and boarding schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. Collège du Léman is a member of the Nord Anglia family of more than 89+ schools worldwide. At Collège du Léman, we shape generations that harness differences, changing our world for the better, and are proud of our “RISE” (Respect, Internationalism, Spirit and Excellence) values. We are a truly international community of more than 120 different nationalities. These come together on a green, village-like campus covering 8 hectares. Students follow national and international curricula, with English, French and Bilingual programmes offered.

jobs.title: Boarding House Tutor
jobs.description:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE Boarding House Tutors are key members of our boarding community, bringing energy, enthusiasm, and a flexible, student-centred approach to daily boarding life. Working closely with the House Parents, they provide pastoral care, support students' well-being and personal development, contribute to the smooth running of the house, and help create a safe, inclusive, and engaging environment. This role is ideal for people looking to gain valuable experience in education, youth development, or pastoral care. As trusted role models, Boarding House Tutors encourage students to develop independence, resilience, confidence, and positive life skills while contributing to a warm and supportive boarding community. KEY RESPONSABILITIES Pastoral Care: Act as a trusted point of contact for students, offering emotional support and practical guidance. Collaborate with House Parents and the Health Centre to ensure students’ emotional, social, and physical well-being. Community Leadership: Foster a positive and inclusive house environment, promoting teamwork, respect, and responsibility. Encourage student engagement in house activities, celebrations, and competitions. Activity Involvement: Participate actively in a range of student activities and excursions, setting a positive example. Support evening, weekend, and holiday activity schedules, promoting student participation. Operational Support : Assist with the daily operations of the house, including meal supervision, laundry oversight, and student wake-up and bedtime routines. Support House Parents in ensuring the house environment is clean, organized, and safe. Administrative Duties: Ensure accurate and timely record-keeping for attendance, student check-ins, and other administrative tasks. Contribute to student progress reports, sharing observations with House Parents and the senior boarding team. Safety and Security: Monitor student whereabouts and ensure they adhere to curfews and daily schedules. Follow protocols for handling missing students, fire drills, and medical emergencies. Role Modeling: Demonstrate empathy, patience, and integrity, embodying the core values of the boarding community. Support students from diverse cultural and linguistic backgrounds as they integrate into boarding life. SKILLS AND COMPETENCES
• Previous experience working with children or young people is highly desirable.
• A positive, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to complete administrative tasks effectively.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is an asset.
• Enthusiasm for boarding life, with a willingness to participate in activities and excursions.
• Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues, students, and parents.
• A driving license is preferred. Driving duties are an integral part of the job.
• Resilience and adaptability to work in a fast-paced, student-centered environment. You are an energetic, enthusiastic, team player, but also resistant to pressure and well organised. You have a good sense of humour and believe in positive and respectful relationships. You have excellent interpersonal skills, especially with students. Your level of English is excellent. Experience in working with children and young people is a prerequisite. You will be exhausted at the end of the day, but the rewards will be extraordinary! WHY JOIN US? Be part of a vibrant international community in a stunning location. Enjoy access to a wide range of professional development opportunities and cultural activities. Benefit from on-campus accommodation and amenities. Make a lasting impact on students’ lives while advancing your career in an environment that values positivity, initiative, and care. TERMS AND CONDITIONS Boarding House Tutor will be required to work throughout the term, with one day off per week and one weekend off once every two weeks. Accommodation in a Boarding House will be provided from the start of the year until the end of the academic year. The monthly salary is CHF2,000.- Meals are also provided during term time. Private health insurance is compulsory in Switzerland, and as part of the package, CDL will offer Health Insurance to eligible Boarding Graduate Assistants, and we will cover up to CHF 250 of their transportation costs for the first travel. Boarding House Tutors will then have priority on the application for our amazing summer camps. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. We welcome children from 2 to 18 years old to become part of a truly international community with more than 120 different nationalities. Our vision is to shape generations that harness differences and empower our students to change the world for the better. We nurture individual strengths through our outstanding educators and the sheer breadth of opportunities that we offer as part of our curriculum and activities. Collège du Léman is part of the Nord Anglia Education family of more than 80 premium schools all over the world.

jobs.description:
Fondée en 2008, La Côte International School ("LCIS") est une école de langue anglaise, qui accueille près de 420 élèves âgés de 2 à 18 ans. Nichée entre les vignobles et les vergers d'Aubonne, en Suisse, l'école internationale de La Côte se trouve à proximité de Genève et de Lausanne. Nous offrons à nos étudiants des expériences d’apprentissage internationales inégalées, inspirées par nos collaborations avec Juilliard, le MIT et l’UNICEF. Notre programme d’études sur mesure offre à nos élèves la possibilité de suivre un parcours en anglais, en français ou bilingue menant au programme du diplôme du baccalauréat international (IBDP), de renommée internationale. C’est dans cet environnement dynamique que nous vous invitons à rejoindre notre équipe : Chauffeur des transports scolaires ~ 60-80% (à l'heure) - dès août 2026 Sous la supervision du coordinateur des transports, vos principales responsabilités seront :
• Transport scolaire lors de la tournée du matin et de l’après-midi (pendant la période scolaire)
• Transport pour les excursions de classe ou sorties régulières hebdomadaires
• Entretien basique des véhicules, nettoyage, contrôles techniques hebdomadaires Votre profil :
• Permis de conduire professionnel Suisse D ou D1, sans limitations, pour conduire les minibus de plus de 3,5 tonnes
• OACP à jour et carte (verte) de qualification de conducteur
• Très bonne connaissance des routes dans la région de La Côte, un atout
• Français ou anglais courant, bon niveau de l'autre langue, un atout
• Facilité de communication et sens de l’accueil
• Bonne gestion du stress
• Aisance manuelle
• Autonomie, organisation, flexibilité et discrétion
• Permis de travail valable
• Extraits de casier judiciaire vierges Intéressé-e à rejoindre notre équipe ? Merci de bien vouloir nous faire parvenir votre dossier complet en format électronique uniquement par le biais de notre site internet.

Location: Geneva, Switzerland Start date: Aug -26 Report to: Heads of House MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE House Parents are at the heart of our boarding community, combining warmth, flexibility, and initiative to foster a nurturing and inspiring environment. They are mentors, role models, and leaders who ensure students feel secure and supported while embracing opportunities for personal growth. This dynamic role requires a proactive and positive approach, as House Parents lead by example—whether through participating in activities, encouraging students to discover their passions, or helping manage day-to-day operations of the boarding house. By setting the standard in enthusiasm and resilience, House Parents inspire students to thrive in all aspects of their lives. K EY RESPONSIBILITIES
• Pastoral Care: Act “in loco parentis” to ensure students’ emotional, social, and physical well-being. Collaborate with the Counselling team and Health Centre to address individual needs​​. Staying overnight in the boarding House when on duty is an expectation.
• Academic Tracking: Monitor students’ academic progress, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals. Liaise with teachers to address concerns and celebrate achievements​​.
• Community Leadership: Encourage teamwork, respect, and responsibility among boarders, instilling core values and promoting a positive house culture​​.
• Activity Involvement: Actively engage in student activities to lead by example, inspiring students to pursue their interests and develop a balanced, passionate approach to life​​.
• Operational Support: Oversee daily logistics such as dining supervision, weekend activities, and occasional transportation, including driving students when required​​.
• Communication: Maintain regular and open communication with parents, providing updates on their child’s well-being, academic progress, and personal development​​.
• Crisis Management: Respond to maintenance issues, medical emergencies, or missing students using established protocols​​​.
• Administrative Duties: Maintain accurate records and ensure all administrative tasks are handled efficiently for the smooth running of the House​​.
• Role Modeling: Exhibit empathy, patience, and cultural sensitivity to help students from diverse backgrounds integrate and thrive​​. S KILLS AND COMPETENCES
• Previous experience working with children or young people.
• A proactive and positive mindset, demonstrating resilience and adaptability in a dynamic environment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage administrative tasks and maintain accurate records.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English. Knowledge of French is a significant asset, as it facilitates communication in a bilingual environment.
• A genuine enthusiasm for boarding life, including leading and participating in student activities.
• A collaborative spirit and ability to build meaningful relationships within a diverse team and student body.
• A valid driving license, as occasional transportation of students is expected.
• A proactive attitude toward personal and professional development. You are an energetic, enthusiastic, team player, but also resistant to pressure and well organised. You have a good sense of humour and believe in positive and respectful relationships. You have excellent interpersonal skills, especially with students. Your level of English is excellent. experience in working with children and young people is a prerequisite. You will be exhausted at the end of the day, but the rewards will be extraordinary! WHY JOIN US? Be part of a vibrant international community in a stunning location. Enjoy access to a wide range of professional development opportunities and cultural activities. Benefit from on-campus accommodation and amenities. Make a lasting impact on students’ lives while advancing your career in an environment that values positivity, initiative, and care. TERM AND CONDITION As a Part-time House Parent you work one day per week and one weekend every other week. Accommodation and meals in a Boarding House will be provided when on duty. You need to have your own accommodation for your days off.Please note that applications are open to European citizens or holders of a Swiss work permit. ESSENTIAL INFORMATION It is important that the post holder is always aware of Child Protection guidelines and observes a professional distance from students whilst still developing effective working and caring relationships. You understand and embrace the importance of diversity and inclusion and stand against discrimination in any form. Background investigations and reference checks for the past ten years will be conducted during the selection process. WHO WE ARE Collège du Léman is one of Switzerland’s most prestigious international day and boarding schools, located on the edge of Lake Geneva in view of the Swiss Alps. Collège du Léman is a member of the Nord Anglia family of more than 80 schools worldwide. At Collège du Léman, we shape generations that harness differences, changing our world for the better, and are proud of our “RISE” (Respect, Internationalism, Spirit and Excellence) values. We are a truly international community of more than 120 different nationalities. These come together on a green, village-like campus covering 8 hectares. Students follow national and international curricula, with English, French and Bilingual programmes offered.

jobs.description:
Fondée en 2008, La Côte International School ("LCIS") est une école de langue anglaise, qui accueille près de 420 élèves âgés de 3 à 18 ans. Nichée entre les vignobles et les vergers d'Aubonne, en Suisse, l'école internationale de La Côte se trouve à proximité de Genève et de Lausanne. Nous offrons à nos étudiants des expériences d’apprentissage internationales inégalées, inspirées par nos collaborations avec Juilliard, le MIT et l’UNICEF. Notre programme d’études sur mesure offre à nos élèves la possibilité de suivre un parcours en anglais, en français ou bilingue menant au programme du diplôme du baccalauréat international (IBDP), de renommée internationale. C’est dans cet environnement dynamique que nous vous invitons à rejoindre notre équipe : Assistant-e Socio-éducatif-ve 100% – dès décembre 2026 Responsibilités:
• Établir des relations positives et bienveillantes avec les élèves, les collègues et les parents.
• Soutenir l’apprentissage, le développement et le bien-être des élèves en répondant à leurs besoins individuels. Accompagner les enfants dans les routines quotidiennes, notamment les repas, l’hygiène, l’habillage, les temps de repos et les transitions, tout en favorisant leur autonomie et en veillant à leur offrir un environnement sûr, bienveillant et épanouissant.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’enseignant(e) de la classe afin de contribuer à la planification et à la mise en œuvre d’activités d’apprentissage stimulantes, notamment dans le cadre d’un accompagnement individuel ou en petits groupes.
• Observer et suivre les progrès des élèves et transmettre ses observations à l’enseignant(e) de la classe, en contribuant, lorsque nécessaire, aux plans d’apprentissage individualisés et aux mesures de soutien.
• Contribuer à créer un environnement d’apprentissage sûr, positif et stimulant et participer à la surveillance et à l’encadrement des élèves tout au long de la journée scolaire ainsi que lors des activités organisées par l’école.
• Faire preuve de professionnalisme, de discrétion et d’une attitude positive, collaborer efficacement avec ses collègues et participer aux formations et activités scolaires pertinentes. Qualifications et compétences :
• CFC d’Assistant/e socio-éducatif/ve (ASE) ou qualification équivalente reconnue en Suisse par le SEFRI – indispensable.
• Bonne connaissance du développement de l’enfant et expérience professionnelle auprès d’enfants en bas âge (0 à 5 ans).
• Une expérience auprès d’enfants d’âge primaire (5 à 11 ans) constituerait un atout.
• Personne proactive et adaptable, faisant preuve d’initiative, de professionnalisme et d’attention aux besoins des autres.
• Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais constituerait un atout important, ainsi qu’une volonté de travailler dans un environnement anglophone.
• Personne bienveillante, patiente et enthousiaste, capable d’établir des relations positives avec les enfants, les parents et les collègues.
• Personne fiable et bien organisée, capable de travailler aussi bien de manière autonome qu’en équipe. Interessé-e à rejoindre note équipe? Merci de bien vouloir nous faire parvenir votre dossier complet en format électronique uniquement par le biais de notre site internet.

jobs.description:
Founded in 2008, La Côte International School is a co-educational, English-language-based day school for students aged 3 to 18. Situated in Aubonne, Switzerland—within easy reach of Geneva and Lausanne—our school is home to nearly 450 students representing a variety of cultures and backgrounds. At LCIS, we offer a unique blend of international education and strong local community ties with English, French, and bilingual pathways, leading to the globally recognized International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP). Through exclusive collaborations with Juilliard, MIT, and UNICEF, we deliver enriching opportunities that inspire students to thrive academically, creatively, and personally. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to join our team as: HR Manager (maternity replacement) 80% – October 2026 to April 2027 As part of the school’s Senior Leadership Team, you would have the following responsibilities:
• Provide customized support to employees and managers alike in any aspects relating to the employee life cycle
• Manage the complete employee life cycle from an administrative viewpoint (contracts, work permit requests, insurances, certificates, HR databases etc)
• Provide payroll related instructions to the Payroll Specialist
• Maintain up-to-date the internal policies, procedures and documentation related to the employees
• Manage all recruitments and support colleagues in any employee relations issues

Through exclusive collaborations with Juilliard, MIT, and UNICEF, we deliver enriching opportunities that inspire students to thrive academically, creatively, and personally. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to join our team as: Teacher of Physical Education (maternity replacement) 100% – from December 2026 to October 2027 Responsibilities:
• Deliver the teaching and learning of physical education throughout the whole school effectively
• Contribute to a programme of trips, excursions, fieldtrips and extracurricular activities
• Coordinate the school ski programme of ski days, residentials, ski club and ski team
• Lead and participate in primary and secondary winter and summer residential trips

• Must be a competent skier who can navigate intermediate to difficult terrain, including race pistes. Experience of racing and a ski qualification would be an advantage
• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least three years’ experience, ideally in an international environment
• Knowledge and proven experience in teaching physical education in early years and primary

• Have the ability to manage a diverse and demanding workload
• Strong organisation skills and use of technology for administration and teaching
• First aid qualification or willingness to achieve this
• Clear criminal extracts
• Valid work permit If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

Fondata nel 2008, La Côte International School è una scuola diurna con base in lingua inglese per studenti dai 3 ai 18 anni. Situata ad Aubonne, in Svizzera, a breve distanza da Ginevra e Losanna, la nostra scuola ospita quasi 450 studenti che rappresentano una varietà di culture e sfondi. A LCIS, offriamo una miscela unica di istruzione internazionale e forti legami della comunità locale con percorsi inglesi, francesi e bilingue, che portano al programma internazionale di diploma di baccalaureato riconosciuto a livello mondiale (IBDP). Attraverso collaborazioni esclusive con Juilliard, MIT e UNICEF, offriamo opportunità di arricchimento che ispirano gli studenti a prosperare accademicamente, creativamente e personalmente. È in questo ambiente dinamico che vi invitiamo a partecipare al nostro team come: Maestro di educazione fisica (sostituzione maternità) 100% – dal dicembre 2026 all'ottobre 2027 Responsabilità:
• Consegnare efficacemente l'insegnamento e l'apprendimento dell'istruzione fisica in tutta la scuola
• Contribuisci a un programma di viaggi, escursioni, gite e attività extracurricolari
• Coordinate il programma scolastico di giornate di sci, residenziali, sci club e ski team
• Piombo e partecipare a viaggi residenziali primari e secondari in inverno e in estate
• Piombo e partecipare al reparto sportivo viaggi residenziali
• Accompagnate le squadre ai tornei sportivi
• Promuovere la salute e la sicurezza delle classi assegnate
• Partecipare allo sviluppo professionale e contribuire alla formazione/incontro regolari del personale
• Migliorare la posizione professionale del corpo docente
• Contribuire allo sviluppo di un atteggiamento positivo tra il dipartimento di educazione fisica e la comunità più ampia attraverso relazioni cooperative, pubblicazioni, concorsi ecc.
• Completare il ruolo di un insegnante di scuola secondaria ogni giorno Qualifiche e competenze:
• Corso di laurea o master in educazione fisica con lo stato QTS o equivalente
• Deve essere uno sciatore competente che può navigare intermedio a terreno difficile, tra cui piste da gara. L'esperienza delle corse e una qualifica di sci sarebbe un vantaggio
• Provato record di eccellenza nell’insegnamento con almeno tre anni di esperienza, idealmente in un ambiente internazionale
• Conoscenza e comprovata esperienza nell'insegnamento dell'educazione fisica nei primi anni e primaria
• L'esperienza nella gestione di viaggi e/o programmi di sci è un vantaggio.
• Fluency in inglese, la capacità di parlare francese sarebbe auspicabile
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e giocatore di squadra
• Avere la capacità di gestire un carico di lavoro diversificato e impegnativo
• Forte capacità organizzative e utilizzo della tecnologia per l'amministrazione e l'insegnamento
• Prima qualifica di aiuto o volontà di raggiungere questo
• Estratti criminali trasparenti
• Permesso di lavoro valido Se condividi la nostra passione per l'istruzione e desideri unirti al nostro team, ti preghiamo di applicarti direttamente online attraverso il nostro sito web.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die La Côte International School wurde 2008 gegründet und ist eine englischsprachige Tagesschule für Schüler im Alter von 3 bis 18 Jahren. Das Hotel liegt in Aubonne, Schweiz - in der Nähe von Genf und Lausanne - unsere Schule ist die Heimat von fast 450 Studenten, die eine Vielzahl von Kulturen und Hintergründen. Bei LCIS bieten wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus internationaler Bildung und starken lokalen Verbindungen mit Englisch, Französisch und zweisprachigen Pfaden, die zum weltweit anerkannten International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP) führen. Durch exklusive Kooperationen mit Juilliard, MIT und UNICEF bieten wir bereichernde Möglichkeiten, die Studenten dazu inspirieren, akademisch, kreativ und persönlich zu gedeihen. In diesem dynamischen Umfeld laden wir Sie ein, sich unserem Team anzuschließen als: Lehrer für Leibeserziehung (Mutterschaftsersatz) 100% - von Dezember 2026 bis Oktober 2027 Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Liefern Sie das Lehren und Lernen von Sportunterricht in der gesamten Schule effektiv
• Beitrag zu einem Programm von Ausflügen, Exkursionen, Exkursionen und außerschulischen Aktivitäten
• Koordinieren Sie das Schulskiprogramm von Skitagen, Wohnhäusern, Skiclub und Skiteam
• Leitung und Teilnahme an primären und sekundären Winter- und Sommeraufenthalten
• Führen und beteiligen Sie sich an der Sportabteilung Wohnreisen
• Begleiten Sie die Teams zu Sportturnieren
• Förderung der Gesundheit und Sicherheit der zugewiesenen Klassen
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der beruflichen Entwicklung und tragen Sie zu regelmäßigen Schulungen / Sitzungen des Personals bei
• Verbessern Sie die professionelle Stellung des Lehrkörpers
• Beitrag zur Entwicklung einer positiven Einstellung zwischen der Sportabteilung und der breiteren Gemeinschaft durch kooperative Beziehungen, Publikationen, Wettbewerbe usw.
• Vervollständigen Sie die Rolle eines Sekundarschullehrers jeden Tag Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten:
• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Sportunterricht mit QTS-Status oder gleichwertig
• Muss ein kompetenter Skifahrer sein, der in schwieriges Gelände, einschließlich Rennpisten, navigieren kann. Rennerfahrung und eine Skiqualifikation wären von Vorteil
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Lehre mit mindestens drei Jahren Erfahrung, idealerweise in einem internationalen Umfeld
• Kenntnisse und nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Sportunterricht in frühen Jahren und in der Grundschule
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung von Reisen und / oder Skiprogrammen ist von Vorteil.
• Englisch fließend, Französisch sprechen zu können wäre wünschenswert
• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamplayer
• Haben Sie die Fähigkeit, eine vielfältige und anspruchsvolle Arbeitsbelastung zu verwalten
• Starke Organisationskompetenzen und Einsatz von Technologie für Verwaltung und Lehre
• Erste Hilfe Qualifikation oder Bereitschaft, dies zu erreichen
• Klare kriminelle Auszüge
• Gültige Arbeitserlaubnis Wenn Sie unsere Leidenschaft für Bildung teilen und unserem Team beitreten möchten, bewerben Sie sich bitte direkt online über unsere Website.

jobs.description:
La Cote International School (LCIS) is a school that aims to make a difference every day. We are passionate about education and seeing young people grow and develop, and we want the same for our colleagues. If you join us, you will become part of a team that is a genuine family, committed to each other and to the students we serve. LCIS is a co-educational, English language based, day school that welcomes nearly 450 students between 3 and 18 years old. Nestled in Switzerland amongst vineyards and fruit orchards, between Lac Léman and the Jura mountains, we are also within very easy commuting distance from Geneva and Lausanne. It is a truly great environment to live and work. We offer our students unparalleled international learning experiences, including those inspired by our collaborations with Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. Our customized curriculum offers our students the opportunity to follow an English, French or bilingual pathway leading to the internationally renowned International Baccalaureate Diploma Program (IBDP), as well as discovering new skills, abilities and interest. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to apply to join our team: Learning Support Assistants (Student Shadows) Speculative applications – primary – secondary – hourly role Responsibilities:
• Provide support to students with additional learning needs within the classroom.
• Motivate students to achieve beyond their potential.
• Encourage students to communicate effectively.
• Help children understand instructions.
• Assist children who need extra support to complete various tasks.
• Supervise group activities.
• Communicate with teachers, the SEN department and parents about student progress. Qualifications and Skills:
• 1-3 years of experience in a similar role.
• Fluency in English; working knowledge of French is an asset.
• Relevant degree.
• Excellent communication skills, discretion, and a team player attitude.
• Empathetic, calm, positive, motivational, creative, and flexible.
• Availability throughout the day and week during school hours.
• Local residency.
• Clear criminal record. If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website. Please note that this is an ongoing advertisement, as we may have unexpected Learning Support needs arise throughout the year, though there may not be an immediate vacancy at this time. If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

jobs.title: Study Coaches
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE ? Collège Champittet, a school of reference in the Lake Geneva region since 1903, offers excellent education to generations of Swiss and foreign students. Its unique spirit revolves around academic performance, multilingualism and values such as respect and trust. The school is part of the Nord Anglia Education family, the world's leading premium schools’ organisation with 89 schools in 32 countries. In this dynamic environment, both local and international, we invite you to join our Boarding Team. JOB DESCRIPTION As a Study Coach, you will support and supervise students aged 11 to 18 during evening study sessions twice a week from 6.00 pm, as well as during sports and cultural activities one weekend per month. You will play a key role in fostering a positive, structured and supportive environment that encourages both academic success and personal development. Profile and competences
• An IB graduate, studying at University, EPFL or Haute Ecole, in Child & Adolescent Psychology, Sciences, Economics or Literature
• Ideally with prior experience working with teenagers, understanding their needs and interests
• A native speaker in French or English with a good command of the other language. Russian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese or Arabic an asset
• Enthusiastic, patient, with natural authority, motivated to impart your knowledge to young people.
• Flexible, integrating easily into a team thanks to good interpersonal skills
• Swiss or European nationality with a valid work permit
• Clean criminal records If you are passionate about education and interested in joining our team, please apply directly online through our website.
